aspect.thaumicunity.abyssus.desc: The Abyss, the dark beyond the dark.
aspect.thaumicunity.aer.desc: The breath of the world: wind, sky and everything that moves unseen.
aspect.thaumicunity.aether.desc: Aether, aura thinned to nothing: the stuff between the stars.
aspect.thaumicunity.aevum.desc: Eternity, the soul that outlasts time.
aspect.thaumicunity.alienis.desc: The eldritch: things from outside the world.
aspect.thaumicunity.animatus.desc: Animation, a soul bound in a machine.
aspect.thaumicunity.aqua.desc: Water in every form; that which flows and fills.
aspect.thaumicunity.arbor.desc: Trees, the old towers of the forest.
aspect.thaumicunity.ars.desc: Art, craft that pleases the senses.
aspect.thaumicunity.astrum.desc: Stars, lights from beyond the world.
aspect.thaumicunity.auram.desc: Aura, the magic that saturates the air.
aspect.thaumicunity.aversio.desc: Aversion; the soul's will to destroy.
aspect.thaumicunity.bestia.desc: Beasts, life that runs and hunts.
aspect.thaumicunity.caelum.desc: The heavens, air among the stars.
aspect.thaumicunity.calamitas.desc: Calamity, a storm that breaks things.
aspect.thaumicunity.calor.desc: Heat born of friction and motion.
aspect.thaumicunity.captio.desc: Capture, the beast in the trap.
aspect.thaumicunity.cinis.desc: Ash, what fire leaves of the dead.
aspect.thaumicunity.cognitio.desc: Mind; the fire of the soul.
aspect.thaumicunity.corpus.desc: Flesh, the body of a beast.
aspect.thaumicunity.corruptio.desc: Corruption, life consumed by flux: the root of taint.
aspect.thaumicunity.daemonium.desc: Demons, souls born of the Nether.
aspect.thaumicunity.desiderium.desc: Desire, the soul reaching for what it lacks.
aspect.thaumicunity.eclipsis.desc: Eclipse, sun and moon in one place.
aspect.thaumicunity.exitium.desc: Destruction, a weapon used to unmake.
aspect.thaumicunity.fabrico.desc: Craft, the work of skilled hands.
aspect.thaumicunity.fertilitas.desc: Fertility, the promise of many harvests.
aspect.thaumicunity.flos.desc: Flowers, plants turned towards the light.
aspect.thaumicunity.fumus.desc: Smoke, ash carried by the wind.
aspect.thaumicunity.fungus.desc: Fungus, plants that prefer the dark.
aspect.thaumicunity.gelum.desc: Cold, the slow theft of heat.
aspect.thaumicunity.grando.desc: Hail, ice thrown by a storm.
aspect.thaumicunity.gravitas.desc: Gravity, the weight of the earth's power.
aspect.thaumicunity.gula.desc: Gluttony, hunger that devours the void.
aspect.thaumicunity.humanus.desc: Humankind, beasts that learned to think.
aspect.thaumicunity.ignis.desc: Flame and heat, the hungry spark of change.
aspect.thaumicunity.imago.desc: Illusion, light that lies to the senses.
aspect.thaumicunity.imperium.desc: Command, the mind that binds others.
aspect.thaumicunity.infernus.desc: The Nether, fire infused with magic.
aspect.thaumicunity.insania.desc: Madness, a mind touched by flux.
aspect.thaumicunity.insectum.desc: Insects, small beasts among the plants.
aspect.thaumicunity.instrumentum.desc: Tools, the extension of the hand.
aspect.thaumicunity.invidia.desc: Envy, the senses fed by hunger.
aspect.thaumicunity.iter.desc: Travel; the road beneath the feet.
aspect.thaumicunity.levitas.desc: Levity, weight given to the void.
aspect.thaumicunity.lignum.desc: Timber, a tree that has died.
aspect.thaumicunity.luna.desc: The Moon, a mirror for the night.
aspect.thaumicunity.machina.desc: Mechanism; tools that move by themselves.
aspect.thaumicunity.magma.desc: Molten rock, the earth on fire.
aspect.thaumicunity.memoria.desc: Memory, the mind holding on to time.
aspect.thaumicunity.messis.desc: Crops, plants raised by human hands.
aspect.thaumicunity.minera.desc: Ore, riches hidden in the earth.
aspect.thaumicunity.mora.desc: Delay, motion caught in a snare.
aspect.thaumicunity.mortuus.desc: Death, the quiet that follows life.
aspect.thaumicunity.motus.desc: Movement for its own sake; the urge to be elsewhere.
aspect.thaumicunity.mutatio.desc: Mutation, life that will not stay the same.
aspect.thaumicunity.nebrisum.desc: Cheating; riches dug up too easily.
aspect.thaumicunity.nix.desc: Snow, frozen breath of the sky.
aspect.thaumicunity.nubes.desc: Clouds, steam carried on the air.
aspect.thaumicunity.odor.desc: Scent, the sense of green things.
aspect.thaumicunity.ordo.desc: Pattern, law and structure; the will to arrange.
aspect.thaumicunity.ossum.desc: Bone, the earth that remains of the dead.
aspect.thaumicunity.pannus.desc: Cloth, woven from beast and tool.
aspect.thaumicunity.perditio.desc: Entropy, decay and undoing; the end of all patterns.
aspect.thaumicunity.perfodio.desc: Mining; digging into the bones of the earth.
aspect.thaumicunity.permutatio.desc: Exchange; one thing given, another taken.
aspect.thaumicunity.porta.desc: Gateway; a road into the outside.
aspect.thaumicunity.potentia.desc: Raw energy, power waiting for a purpose.
aspect.thaumicunity.praecantatio.desc: Magic itself, energy shaped by intent.
aspect.thaumicunity.praemunio.desc: The soul's will to endure and guard.
aspect.thaumicunity.primordium.desc: The Primordial; what existed before time began.
aspect.thaumicunity.profanus.desc: Profanity, the soul corrupted by flux.
aspect.thaumicunity.radio.desc: Radiation, light too energetic to be kind.
aspect.thaumicunity.rota.desc: Rotation, the endless turning of machines.
aspect.thaumicunity.rubigo.desc: Rust, the slow death of metal.
aspect.thaumicunity.sanguis.desc: Blood, the river of life within the flesh.
aspect.thaumicunity.sano.desc: Healing; life set back in order.
aspect.thaumicunity.sapor.desc: Taste, the sense of the harvest.
aspect.thaumicunity.scientia.desc: Science, the mind put in order.
aspect.thaumicunity.silentium.desc: Silence, sound swallowed by the void.
aspect.thaumicunity.sol.desc: The Sun, the fire of the day.
aspect.thaumicunity.somnium.desc: Dream, the mind wandering in darkness.
aspect.thaumicunity.spatium.desc: Space, the empty distance between places.
aspect.thaumicunity.spiritus.desc: Soul, that which remains when the body is gone.
aspect.thaumicunity.tactus.desc: Touch, the sense of the flesh.
aspect.thaumicunity.tempestas.desc: The temper of the sky: rain, gusts and gathering storms.
aspect.thaumicunity.tenebrae.desc: Darkness, the absence that light leaves behind.
aspect.thaumicunity.terra.desc: Solid ground, stone and soil; the patience of the world.
aspect.thaumicunity.vacuos.desc: Emptiness that hungers to be filled.
aspect.thaumicunity.venatio.desc: The hunt, a beast with a weapon.
aspect.thaumicunity.venenum.desc: Poison: water that has learned to harm.
aspect.thaumicunity.verbum.desc: Incantation, the spoken shape of magic.
aspect.thaumicunity.veritas.desc: Truth, the mind in full light.
aspect.thaumicunity.vestigium.desc: Trace, the signs a traveller leaves.
aspect.thaumicunity.vis.desc: Raw vis, aura charged with power.
aspect.thaumicunity.vitium.desc: Flux: magic spoiled by careless use.
aspect.thaumicunity.vocatio.desc: Summoning; calling a soul across distance.
aspect.thaumicunity.volatus.desc: Flight, the freedom of the air.

pack.thaumicunity.modern_combinations.de: Thaumcraft 6 component pairs for shared aspects
research.thaumicunity.alchemy.alchemical: Some substances burn too eagerly for a furnace. Scan glowstone dust and gunpowder to see why.

Nitor is a captured flame that never goes out, wanted wherever a device needs light. Alumentum burns hot enough to drive an alchemical furnace for a long time. Magic tallow, rendered from rotten flesh, is the base of arcane candles.
research.thaumicunity.alchemy.crucible.s:
Salis Mundus turns a cauldron into a crucible. Fill it with water and keep a fire, lava, magma or a campfire under it; once it boils, anything thrown in dissolves into its essentia.

Make an observation in Alchemy.

Throw in a catalyst while the right essentia is dissolved and it becomes something new, using up exactly the essentia the recipe needs. A crucible holds only so much; what overflows becomes flux. Empty it by using it with an empty hand while sneaking.
research.thaumicunity.alchemy.enchanted_:
Wool dipped in a crucible of Praecantatio and Vinculum keeps the magic woven into it.

Make an observation in Alchemy.
Enchanted fabric lines robes, bags and bindings that must hold magic in.
research.thaumicunity.alchemy.essentia.s:
Dissolved essentia does not keep. To store it you need warded glass and a furnace that distils instead of smelting.

Make two observations in Alchemy.

The alchemical furnace boils items into essentia and pushes it into a warded jar above it. A jar holds one aspect at a time; label it with paper to keep it that way. Phials carry ten points of essentia from jar to jar.
research.thaumicunity.alchemy.metallurgy:
Metal remembers what it was steeped in. Iron dropped into a crucible heavy with Praecantatio comes out as thaumium, which holds magic the way copper holds heat.

Solve the puzzle linking Metallum and Vitreus.
Thaumium is the backbone of every arcane device. Brass, copper hardened with Metallum and Ordo, makes fine fittings for instruments.
research.thaumicunity.alchemy.vis_crysta:
An amethyst shard steeped in a single primal grows into a crystal of that primal's vis.

Develop a theory of Alchemy.
Six crystals, one for each primal. They are the raw stuff of the more demanding arcane recipes.
research.thaumicunity.artifice.amber.sta:
Two minerals turn up wherever the aura is old: amber, which holds things still, and cinnabar, which smelts down into quicksilver.

Scan some amber and some cinnabar.
Both are common in recipes of every field.
research.thaumicunity.artifice.arcane_st: Stone worked at the arcane workbench takes on a faint violet sheen and a stubborn hardness. It is the builder's first arcane material.
research.thaumicunity.artifice.goggles.s:
Two thaumometer lenses in a leather strap.

Make two observations in Artifice.
Wearing the goggles shows the aura as if you were holding a thaumometer and reveals the aspects of scanned items without holding Shift.
research.thaumicunity.auromancy.advanced: Solve the puzzle linking Potentia and Ignis.
Spells that combine two effects can produce a third: fire and water together scald, air and fire flare. These foci use that.
A caster's gauntlet channels the aura through a focus held in the other hand. The focus decides what the spell does; the gauntlet decides how much vis it draws and how strongly it casts.

Make two observations in Auromancy.
Spells cost primal vis, taken from the aura around you. A blank focus does nothing until a spell is set into it.
research.thaumicunity.auromancy.flux.sta: Every spell adds a little flux to the aura where it is cast, and the more vis a spell costs, the more flux it leaves. Cast where the aura is strong, move on before it is drained, and give overworked places time to recover.
research.thaumicunity.auromancy.foci.sta: Six spells every apprentice learns. Each is set into a blank focus at the arcane workbench: embers, frost shards, excavation, mending, gale and warding.
research.thaumicunity.auromancy.master_f: Light and lightning, split into seeking stars.
research.thaumicunity.fundamentals.arcan:
Sprinkle Salis Mundus on an ordinary crafting table and it becomes an Arcane Workbench. It still crafts everything a crafting table can, but it also draws vis, the raw magic of the world, out of the air around it and spends it on recipes that need more than skill.

The six primal costs of a recipe are shown around the grid. The vis comes from the aura of the chunk the workbench stands in; a place attuned to a primal pays less of that primal.
research.thaumicunity.fundamentals.aspec:
Everything is made of aspects, and every aspect is made of two others, down to the six primals: Aer, Terra, Ignis, Aqua, Ordo and Perditio.

Scan some grass, a cow and an iron ingot.

Aspects can be combined: Aer and Ignis make Lux, Lux and Vacuos make Tenebrae, and so on, two hundred times over. Hold Shift over an item to see its aspects once you have scanned it.

The aspect points you gain from scanning are the ink of research: you spend them solving insight puzzles at the research table.
Every chunk of the world holds a reservoir of vis. It slowly refills to a level set by the land: forests and mushroom fields are rich, deserts poor, and the Nether and the End richer still. Each place also favours some primals over others.

Scan an amethyst shard, the most common crystal of raw magic.

Magic is never clean. Spending vis leaves flux behind, and flux makes the aura heal more slowly. Where too much flux gathers it stops dissipating, and strange things begin to happen. Spread your work out, and let the land rest.
research.thaumicunity.fundamentals.insig:
An insight puzzle is a hexagonal board with a few fixed aspects at its corners. Fill the cells between them with aspects from your points so that every fixed aspect is connected to the others through a chain of neighbours, where each neighbour is a component of the next (Aer sits next to Lux, Lux next to Ignis).

Solve the puzzle that links Aer and Ignis.
Solved notes are proof of understanding. In unified research every solved puzzle also earns a theory in the field it belongs to.
research.thaumicunity.fundamentals.resea:
Salis Mundus turns a lectern into a research table. Put scribing tools in its upper slot and paper in the lower one.

Obtain a research table.

With blank paper on the table, the table lists every insight puzzle your current research asks for. Choosing one writes a fresh puzzle on the paper and uses a little ink.

The table can also turn two observations of a field into one theory, at the cost of a sheet of paper.
research.thaumicunity.fundamentals.thaum:
Magic hides in plain sight. A lens of amethyst in a gold frame, assembled at the arcane workbench, lets you see the aspects that things are made of.

Craft a Thaumometer to continue.

Point the thaumometer at a block or a creature and use it to scan it; with nothing in sight, it scans the item in your other hand. Each new scan teaches you the aspects of what you looked at and gives you points of those aspects for your research. While you hold it, it also shows the aura of the place you stand in.

Every scholar of the arcane keeps a book, and this one keeps itself. Pages fill as you learn; diagrams redraw themselves when you understand them better.

The first discovery every thaumaturge makes is Salis Mundus, a salt that remembers the shape of things. Grind redstone, glowstone, bone meal and an amethyst shard together and sprinkle the result on a bookshelf, and a copy of this book appears. Sprinkled on other things, it does other things. Read on.
research.thaumicunity.fundamentals.theor:
Scanning things grants observations in the fields their aspects belong to. Two observations can be worked into a theory at the research table, and theories pay for the deeper secrets of each field.

Develop one theory of Fundamentals.
Keep scanning. Every field (Alchemy, Artifice, Infusion, Auromancy) has its own observations, and the book tells you which ones each discovery needs.
research.thaumicunity.infusion.greater_f: Infused gems make foci that can hold more of a spell: the adept's focus takes three effects and three modifiers, the archmage's focus four effects, five modifiers and nested spells.
research.thaumicunity.infusion.runic_mat:
Infusion binds essentia and items into one object. Place the item to be infused on an arcane pedestal, set a runic matrix two blocks above it, and ring the pedestal with more pedestals holding the components. The essentia is drawn from warded jars nearby.

Develop a theory of Infusion.
Use the matrix with a casting instrument (or Salis Mundus) to begin. The matrix pulls essentia one point at a time, then absorbs the components one by one.
research.thaumicunity.infusion.stability: Solve the puzzle linking Ordo and Vitreus.

An infusion that is unstable lashes out: essentia spills as flux, components are flung away, the air itself bites. Symmetric pedestals, fewer components and calm, flux-free surroundings all help, and so do stabilisers placed around the altar: candles, skulls, amethyst clusters and enchanting tables.
research.thaumicunity.infusion.thaumium_:
A caster's gauntlet can be infused with thaumium.

Obtain a caster's gauntlet.
The thaumium gauntlet casts with a quarter more power and draws vis more efficiently.
